findings.title: First-signal owned-part cleanup independently passes
findings.evidence: Exact copied repaired production CLI: blocked fetch and unresolved body x SIGINT/SIGTERM; no fixture keepalive; owned part observed before signal and absent after exit130/143; unrelated file retained. Exact old candidate fails actual SIGINT fetch/body controls with one part retained.

decisiveEvidence: All 25 repair closure files and all 16 original rejected-review files match their frozen bytes. Config remains byte-identical with 13 unique assets; runtime/build/all select2/7/9 for all three targets.
Four first-signal real CLI cases use no fixture timer/server/IPC/network/file keeper. A parent80ms delay proves the production event-loop keeper handles an otherwise unreferenced pending promise.
Four historical controls discriminate: two no-handle stalls exit13 before signal, two fixture-kept actual SIGINT cases exit by SIGINT; all retain one part. These are separate results.
A repaired forced-second-signal case exits143 and retains a part as disclosed; forced termination is not ordinary cancellation.

26 independent admission/transport/path regressions pass, including complete331846890-byte native/WASM streaming publication and standalone API+CLI offline verification. Original archive bytes are rehashed afterward.
Guide separates download verification from build configuration, extraction, host integration, native/public qualification and product parity.
highestLeverageRemainingGap: No blocking gap within this downloader repair threshold. Validate Windows console semantics separately before making a Windows signal-cleanup claim.

limitations: Execution is macOS ARM64 Node24.18.0; Windows console/process termination and macOS x64 downloader execution were not exercised.
Controlled local responses exercise transport; no public assets are redownloaded and this review grants no public native or WASM runtime qualification.
No private host, Windows11 acceptance, Microsoft Office/Adobe parity or whole-product completion is granted.

The review received repair summaries and original rejection context; behavioral fixtures and verdict were authored independently of the builder.
confidence: HIGH for the scoped repair threshold; no broader product acceptance.
